session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Lower High Double Top MTR, Small Pullback Bear Trend'. A big gap up runs to 5355 but a low 2 lower high double top forms a major trend reversal; a higher low double bottom at the EMA only buys a small swing, then the small pullback bear trend grinds to 5225 and even a bull trap at the EMA around 5255 fails into the close.

events.label: bull_trend
events.raw_label: Big gap up rally from the open to 5355
events.outcome_reason: big gap up produced a bull open that ran to 5355

events.label: double_top
events.raw_label: Low 2 / Lower high major trend reversal after big gap up
events.outcome_reason: low 2 lower high double top major trend reversal after the big gap up rolled the market over
events.evidence: red dotted double top line at 5355 with red arrows at 07:30 and 08:15

events.label: double_bottom
events.raw_label: Higher low double bottom at EMA
events.outcome_reason: higher low double bottom at the EMA gave a small bull swing back under 5355
events.evidence: green boxed bars 07:45-08:00 and green text under the pullback low 5325

events.label: wedge
events.raw_label: Wedge bear flag at the 09:30-09:45 lows
events.outcome_reason: wedge bear flag around 5305 kept bears in control and the trend resumed down
events.evidence: magenta dotted wedge lines under the 09:15-09:45 swing

events.label: bear_trend
events.outcome_reason: small pullback bear trend with red arrows ground the market down to 5225 by the close
events.evidence: successive red arrows over pullbacks from 5355 down to 5228

events.label: failed_breakout
events.outcome_reason: bull trap at the EMA after the 5255 breakout to the upside sold the close down to 5228
events.evidence: brown boxed 12:30 breakout bars with magenta wedge into 5258 and close sell-off bars
